name: mellin
result.type: {E : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] → [NormedSpace ℂ E] → (ℝ → E) → ℂ → E
result.value:
:=
  ∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, (t : ℂ) ^ (s - 1) • f t
result.informal_description: The Mellin transform of a function $ f : \mathbb{R} \to E $ at a complex number $ s $ is defined as the Bochner integral over $ (0, \infty) $ of $ t^{s - 1} \cdot f(t) $ with respect to the Lebesgue measure, resulting in an element of the Banach space $ E $.

name: LSeries_deriv_eqOn
result.signature: {f : ℕ → ℂ} : {s | abscissaOfAbsConv f < s.re}.EqOn (deriv (LSeries f)) (-LSeries (logMul f))
result.type: ∀ {f : ℕ → ℂ}, Set.EqOn (deriv (LSeries f)) (-LSeries (LSeries.logMul f)) {s | LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv f < ↑s.re}
result.informal_name: Derivative of $L(f, s)$ Equals $-L(\log \cdot f, s)$ on Half-Plane of Absolute Convergence
result.informal_description: For any arithmetic function $ f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C} $, the derivative of the L-series $ L(f, s) $ satisfies $ L'(f, s) = -L(g, s) $, where $ g(n) = \log n \cdot f(n) $, for all complex numbers $ s $ with $ \operatorname{Re}(s) > \sigma_a(f) $, where $ \sigma_a(f) $ denotes the abscissa of absolute convergence of $ f $.

name: Real
deriv_fourier
result.signature:
{f : ℝ → E} (hf : Integrable f) (hf' : Integrable (fun x : ℝ ↦ x • f x)) :
  deriv (𝓕 f) = 𝓕 (fun x : ℝ ↦ (-2 * π * I * x) • f x)
result.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] {f : ℝ → E},
  MeasureTheory.Integrable f MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => x • f x) MeasureTheory.volume →
      deriv (FourierTransform.fourier f) = FourierTransform.fourier fun x => (-2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑x) • f x
result.value:
:= by
  ext x
  exact (hasDerivAt_fourier hf hf' x).deriv
result.informal_name: Derivative of Fourier Transform: $\mathcal{F}'(f) = \mathcal{F}(-2\pi i x f)$
result.informal_description: For an integrable function $f : \mathbb{R} \to E$ such that the function $x \mapsto x \cdot f(x)$ is also integrable, the derivative of the Fourier transform $\mathcal{F}f$ is equal to the Fourier transform of the function $x \mapsto -2\pi i x \cdot f(x)$. This identity holds under the standard Fourier transform structure defined by the additive character $e^{2\pi i x}$ and the Haar measure on $\mathbb{R}$.

name: HasDerivAt
tendsto_slope_zero
result.signature:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {F : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : 𝕜 → F} {f' : F} {x : 𝕜},
  HasDerivAt f f' x → Filter.Tendsto (fun t => t⁻¹ • (f (x + t) - f x)) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds f')
result.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {F : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : 𝕜 → F} {f' : F} {x : 𝕜},
  HasDerivAt f f' x → Filter.Tendsto (fun t => t⁻¹ • (f (x + t) - f x)) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds f')
result.informal_name: Derivative Implies Limit of Difference Quotient
result.informal_description: If a function $ f: \mathbb{K} \to F $ has derivative $ f' \in F $ at a point $ x \in \mathbb{K} $, where $ \mathbb{K} $ is a nontrivially normed field and $ F $ is a normed vector space over $ \mathbb{K} $, then the difference quotient $ t^{-1} \cdot (f(x + t) - f(x)) $ converges to $ f' $ as $ t \to 0 $ (with $ t \neq 0 $).

name: HasDerivAt
tendsto_nhdsNE
result.signature: (h : HasDerivAt f f' x) (hf' : f' ≠ 0) : Tendsto f (𝓝[≠] x) (𝓝[≠] f x)
result.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {F : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : 𝕜 → F} {f' : F} {x : 𝕜},
  HasDerivAt f f' x → f' ≠ 0 → Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ) (nhdsWithin (f x) {f x}ᶜ)
result.informal_name: Non-zero Derivative Implies Limit in Punctured Neighborhood
result.informal_description: If a function $ f $ has derivative $ f' $ at a point $ x $ in a nontrivially normed field $ \mathbb{K} $, and $ f' \neq 0 $, then $ f $ tends to $ f(x) $ in the punctured neighborhood of $ x $, i.e., $ \lim_{h \to x, h \neq x} f(h) = f(x) $.

name: HasDerivAt
tendsto_slope
result.signature:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {F : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : 𝕜 → F} {f' : F} {x : 𝕜},
  HasDerivAt f f' x → Filter.Tendsto (slope f x) (nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ) (nhds f')
result.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {F : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : 𝕜 → F} {f' : F} {x : 𝕜},
  HasDerivAt f f' x → Filter.Tendsto (slope f x) (nhdsWithin x {x}ᶜ) (nhds f')
result.informal_name: Slope Tends to Derivative at a Point
result.informal_description: If a function $ f $ has derivative $ f' $ at a point $ x $ in a nontrivially normed field $ \mathbb{K} $, then the slope $ \frac{f(b) - f(x)}{b - x} $ converges to $ f' $ as $ b $ approaches $ x $ within the complement of $ \{x\} $.
